messages:
Alex: Quiet window in ~2h. Posting a compact pre-freeze checklist so oncall and release owners know actions. Keep updates here only.

Maria: Ill publish the release notes and a short migration summary in 10m. Link will be pinned here and in the releases channel.

Sam: Are we locking main -> v3.5.0 for the 24h freeze? Need to ensure tags and docs are matched.

Alex: Yes pin v3.5.0 for the duration. No unpins except with SRE-Oncall + Eng Lead signoff.

Deploy Bot: deploy scheduled by @Alex  canary ramp (8% traffic) at 2801238000 UTC. Status: scheduled.

SRE-Oncall: Preflight smoke checklist (short):
- verify no active DB migrations in prod
- run `/smoke run canary --stage=preflight` at -30
- confirm critical cron jobs muted
- check egress quotas
Ill execute and post results.

Jordan: Rollback triggers: error-rate > 1.2% sustained for 6m OR p95 latency > 1.8s for 8m -> auto rollback. Also manual rollback on any schema incompatibility or DB connection errors.

Lina: Note: embeddings ingestion job runs at 01:00 and historically spikes worker count. Recommend disabling that cron for the freeze and setting ingestion concurrency=0/1 as a safety.

Priya: Devex: Ive updated the quickstart to mention the freeze and a short note for SDK retries. Will link docs.

Maria: Release notes published: https://internal.redwood/release/3.5.0  includes API changes, deprecation table, and a short workaround for known UI pagination issue.

Sam: `deploy-bot pin v3.5.0` executed. Pin shows locked. Sam + SRE-Oncall added as emergency unpin approvers.

SRE-Oncall: Can copy this condensed rollback snippet for quick use in ops channel:
```
# canary rollback
kubectl -n prod set image deploy/api api=redwood/api:v3.4.9
deploy-bot unpin v3.5.0
kubectl rollout status deploy/api -n prod --watch
```

Alex: Important: if any DB migration requires a backfill, do NOT proceed with rollout. Stop and escalate to @Jordan and @Alex.

Deploy Bot: canary started -> 8% traffic. Monitoring: https://monitoring.redwood/canary/3.5.0

SRE-Oncall: Preflight smoke run at -25m -> PASS. No migration locks or long-running queries observed. Will re-run at +12m.

Priya: Noted small clients on the webhook beta will receive a post-freeze notice. Ill coordinate an email with product.

Jordan: Im on watch for SLO drift and query timeouts. Ping `@Jordan` if any alert hits P0.

Alex: Rollout ladder: stable if canary green at +15m -> 35% at +30m -> 65% at +60m -> full at +120m. Well pause between steps for 10m observation windows.

Lina: Embeddings cron disabled and concurrency set to 1. Confirmed.

Maria: Pinned the release notes in the channel. Added a short line in the notes about pausing client syncs that schedule heavy writes.

Sam: Emergency rollback playbook uploaded to ops docs. Also added a short checklist for post-rollback communication and postmortem owner.

Deploy Bot: 35% ramp executed at +31m. Monitoring dashboard: https://monitoring.redwood/rollouts/3.5.0

SRE-Oncall: Observability: traces and error budget look normal. No spikes in span errors. Continuing 10m watch.

Alex: GO for the initial ramp. If anything odd, reply in this thread and also page the paging channel. Final status check-in at +2h for lift or any incidents.

Maria: After freeze lifts, well run a short validation: subset of integration tests and a customer smoke run. Will schedule that in the post-freeze checklist.

Jordan: If rollback happens, doc owner for postmortem is @Sam unless otherwise assigned.

Alex: Thanks everyone. Keep updates concise. This thread will be the single source of truth for this rollout window.
